[[Buildings]] are structures that can be constructed and upgraded to unlock [[Research]]es, [[Troops]], and other game mechanics.

==City==
The '''City''' is the inner core of your base, it's constructed around your Fortress and Dragon Keep, and is surrounded by a protective Wall.
{{#invoke:Buildings/Tablemaker|table|location=city}}

==Fields==
The '''Fields''' are the outer part of your City, it's where you gather your [[Resources]].
{{#invoke:Buildings/Tablemaker|table|location=field}}

==Water Outpost==
The '''Water Outpost''' is the first expansion of your empire. It allows you to control the [[Water Dragon]], train [[Fangtooth]]s, and generate a new item, the [[Fangtooth Respirator]].
{{#invoke:Buildings/Tablemaker|table|location=water_outpost}}

==Stone Outpost==
The '''Stone Outpost''' is the second expansion of your empire. It allows you to control the [[Stone Dragon]], train [[Granite Ogre]]s, and generate a new item, the [[Glowing Mandrake]].
{{#invoke:Buildings/Tablemaker|table|location=stone_outpost}}

==Fire Outpost==
The '''Fire Outpost''' is the third expansion of your empire. It allows you to control the [[Fire Dragon]], train [[Lava Jaw]]s, and generate a new item, the [[Volcanic Rune]].
{{#invoke:Buildings/Tablemaker|table|location=fire_outpost}}
